**The job you're trying to do**
What you're estimating and where the current tools fall short. Real workflow beats abstract feature — "I trace corridors and need X" is perfect.

**Proposed behavior**
What it should do, ideally down to the click-by-click.

**What you use today**
If another tool does this, describe the behavior and what you'd keep or change — describe what it does, not the brand; we build our own take, not copies.

**Planning to work on this issue?**
Before starting or requesting assignment, read [CLA.md](https://github.com/Kentucky-ai/opentakeoff/blob/main/CLA.md)
and post its agreement text yourself, or link your earlier agreement comment.
Reporting or discussing this issue does not require signing.
